answer_1.quote: We choose the text-to-SQL task to test LLMs' ability to handle novel interpretations because of its relevance to real-world applications.

answer_2.quote: We use a metric called Relative Performance to measure the generalization ability of models towards acquiring novel interpretations. Our metric provides a measure that is relative to the performance of the model on the corresponding base examples: Relative Performance = min(EX NI / EX base , 1) × 100 where EX NI is the execution accuracy on the examples with novel interpretations from MAG-NIFICO and EX base is the execution accuracy on the corresponding base examples.
